takes.notes: REQUEST S05-SH140-a, draft. Claude's read: photographic, no previz look copied. The corner reads: the tall street lamp with its arm over the road, traffic lights, the concrete wall at the right, towers behind. Low sun behind the towers (backlit, long shadows toward camera), not from screen right as written. The crowd is all men and mills toward the corner rather than visibly closing over him; I cannot pick him out at 480p. Near silence 0.3 to 3.8 s, then the gunshot at about 3.8 s: an arm with the gun goes up from the middle of the crowd with a puff of smoke, everyone flinches, a few run at once, others later, the crowd scatters by 6 s. T02: no previz, study the angle only; he struggles, reaches into his inner pocket while holding the briefcase, then points up and shoots; the crowd gathers slowly, few people at first; a different angle with the wall behind him, no open space.

REQUEST S05-SH140-b, draft, no previz. Four people at first in two pairs, more arrive from both sides and behind camera from about 3 s, backs filling the foreground. His right hand goes into the jacket at about 2.5 s and works there until about 5 s; the gun comes up at about 5.5 s and is held up nearly 2 s before the shot at about 7.4 s. [ASSUMPTION] the briefcase in his hand, per Leonard's note, conflicts with SH120 and the S09 body map. Leonard 2026-11-18: "the shot is good, maybe a bit more handheld." T03: the crowd closer and aggressive, ready to fight; he more scared, walking backwards with the briefcase, frantic reach into the pocket, prop_gun element; when the gun comes out he is almost hidden by the crowd; on the shot some run, some jump back, a few far away frozen in fear.

takes.notes: REQUEST S05-SH145 (Leonard: 'ok generate it 720, be sure it's shot from below looking at one of the buildings'). No start frame: a view from below needs a new angle, so the location plate went in as the image of the place. Claude's read (stills at 2 fps; 1470x630, 6.08 s, audio present, mean -33.8 dB, not listened to): steep low angle on an ochre concrete block with jutting balconies, the S06 wall along the bottom of the frame, hazy cream sky. At 0 s the pigeons sit in a neat even row on the roof edge (too tidy); they burst at about 0.5 s and scatter unevenly, gone by about 2.5 s. A balcony door with dark shutters is already open from the first frame; she appears in it at about 4 s and stands at the railing, more in view than half hidden: white-blonde hair, pale skin, pale blue dress. She is small in frame: the push-in is slight. Same building type as the plate (concrete, balconies), not the same facade: plain framed windows, few louvered shutters, almost no cables. Brighter and flatter than SH140 T03: a pale sky, softer shadows. Leonard 2026-11-21: "no": the building looks too Middle Eastern, should look more modern; the pigeons look fake, put them on a roof we never see so they are not on an awkward line; the camera must feel natural and unplanned, like a documentary, the woman unexpected, never an intentional slow zoom.

REQUEST S05-SH145-c, not yet rated by Leonard. Three changes from T01 (Leonard's notes): modern building, roof out of sight, documentary camera. Claude's read (stills at 2 fps and 10 fps over 3.3-4.5 s; 1470x630, 6.08 s, audio present, mean -33.8 dB, not listened to): a plain 1970s block, beige render, aluminium windows, roller blinds, thin railings: reads modern. The roof edge is in frame (not out of sight as asked) and at 0 s a few pigeons stand spread along it, not a tidy row; they burst at about 0.5 s with motion-blurred wings and scatter, gone by about 2.5 s. The camera drifts up with them, holds on the sky edge, then at about 3.5 s she appears tiny at a lower right window and the camera snaps in on her in about 0.4 s with motion blur, focus catching up a beat late, ending on a medium shot of her at the window: a fast reactive crash zoom, not a tilt. She holds the curtain, half in view, and looks almost into the lens rather than down past it. The building is a different design from the S06 plate facades. Grade warm and soft, pale sky. Leonard 2026-11-21: "I ask for realism, for documentary feel, what the fuck was that".

REQUEST S05-SH145-d, not yet rated by Leonard. Claude's read (stills at 2 fps, 10 fps over 0-1.2 s, a crop of her at 5.5 s; 1470x630, 6.08 s, audio present, mean -32.3 dB, not listened to): a tall modern slab block with ribbon windows, roller blinds and curtains, seen crooked from below: reads modern, more than five floors. The roof edge is in frame again and at 0 to 0.3 s a long tight line of pigeons sits along it; they lift at about 0.3 s, a big flock hugging the roof edge until about 0.8 s, then scattered sky, gone by about 2.5 s. About twenty pigeons drop into frame from above at about 0.5 s and flap down and across past the windows, a few large and blurred close to the lens, gone by about 2 s. The frame drifts slightly, no zoom. At about 4 s a window in the upper middle opens outward and the woman leans into the gap: short ash-blonde hair, pale skin, pale blue dress, cardigan, readable at the end; she looks down to the left. One open window.

REQUEST S06-SH010-a, draft. Claude's read from stills: photoreal, golden low sun from screen left, follows the animatic blocking: he stands left of center facing camera, gun out along his right arm toward screen left, smoke at the muzzle for the first 2 s, briefcase in his left hand all through. REQUEST S06-SH010-c, draft, Leonard's notes on T02 (a bit less crouched; townspeople face him, not the camera). The two men at screen right are turned toward him, arms reaching toward him, in profile. The people at far left walk slowly toward the camera, faces roughly toward camera and him at once: their direction is ambiguous. He mostly holds his spot with small shifts, little backward walking. Smoke at the muzzle early; the gun catches a pale highlight around 1 s. One man near camera wears a white skullcap. Audio present (mean -25 dB), voice not checked by ear. takes.notes: REQUEST S06-SH020-a, draft, not yet rated by Leonard. Claude's read: photographic, no previz look; over-the-shoulder framing and turns follow the guide. Loud audio events at 2.5, 5.4, 7.6, 9.3 and 10.5 s match the planned shots (2.6, 5.4, 7.6, 9.3, 10.6), plus peaks at 9.8 and 11.1 s, not checked by ear. Men drop and stay down; last frame shows three bodies in frame (one mid-distance center, one at the bottom near him, one bottom right). Briefcase in his left hand (visible in the last frame). Gun dark. Hair: thinning brown, which matches the char_politician_blood image (Claude first called it a defect: the prompt wrongly said white, carried over from older prompts). Parked cars and a street lamp in the background; the lamp is not beside him. Leonard 2026-11-19: no. He moves like a bad videogame (Claude's prompt error: the cold, no-panic tactic, the rigid extended arm, the game-like guide clip); he must be much angrier and realistic, panicking, he does not want to shoot: he warns them, yells at them to stay back, they don't listen; after each kill another gets enraged and runs at him saying he will kill him; the crowd denser, chaos, some run away, some forward; the street a lot tighter. T02: no guide clip, loc_side-street instead of loc_square (narrow street), his yelled lines and a runner's threat, untrained trembling gun hand, jostled camera.

REQUEST S06-SH020-b, draft, not yet rated by Leonard. Claude's read (contact sheet and last frame, not watched at speed, audio not checked by ear): narrow street, facades close on both sides, backlit golden haze, photographic. He stands with his left shoulder against the wall, briefcase in his left hand, profile visible in some frames. Runners break out one at a time and drop; the last frame shows three men on the asphalt in frame (left sidewalk about 5 m, center about 6 m, center-right about 3 m). Changes for T03: the first man charges with a crowbar; more people panic after each shot; a diverse crowd (Asian, white, Black, European, women); he fires only when it is the only thing he can do; start slow, speed up later.

REQUEST S06-SH020-c, draft, not yet rated by Leonard. After the first shot the crowd breaks and runs; later shots come faster. Briefcase in his left hand, his back to the wall at left. Leonard 2026-11-19: better, but the crowbar is gigantic (make it a rusty pipe); he is against a car, he must be against a wall; not everyone runs away: at first they run, then for every man he drops two get furious and run at him and two get scared and flee.

REQUEST S06-SH020-d, draft, not yet rated by Leonard. The pipe man walks out, charges with it raised and is shot at about 5 s; the pipe lies on the asphalt. From then on men break out and charge one after another, and at the end three men are running at him while others flee: the escalation reads. Last frame: four men lying in a cluster in the middle of the street plus one at the bottom right edge. Weak: 0-4 s the crowd is again a still wall of men in rows; no women visible, the crowd looks alike (heavy-set men in light shirts); two parked cars far down the street; his gun arm mostly straight. Leonard 2026-11-19: getting closer overall; the location is wrong: he must be near a flat wall, and the street slightly wider.

REQUEST S06-SH020-e, draft, not yet rated by Leonard. The street is about as narrow as T04, at most a little wider. Pipe man shot at about 5 s, the pipe lies on the asphalt; the charges escalate, the last frame has about five men running at him and four or five lying in front of him. shots.description: From behind him, over his shoulder, the gun out in front of him. Around him the crowd: some run, some crouch, some creep forward, slow and hesitant. A MAN yells and runs at him. He aims and fires. The man drops dead. Another runs, from another side. He fires. Another, and another, closer and closer together, until he is firing at one after another.
shots.framing: THIRD PERSON, behind him, over his shoulder
shots.movement: Handheld, close behind him, turning with him as he aims
shots.note: Like a third-person action game. The gun aims along his extended right arm at each runner he shoots. Shots 2 to 6 of 8. The crowd reacts, nobody stands still: some run, some creep forward very slowly, some crouch, some panic. Every man he hits drops where he is, each in a different spot, and stays there for the rest of the film
shots.body_map: Body map from the approved take T05 (last frame, read by Claude, approximate; replaces the d11 map). He stands with his back and left side to a flat plain concrete wall at the mouth of a street about 8 to 12 m wide, facing down it. The five men lie in front of him, all within about 2 to 6 m, in the left half and middle of the street: one at about 1.5 m, front-left, legs toward the left curb; one at about 3 m, straight ahead, the short rusty pipe on the asphalt just to its right; one at about 5 m, center-left; one at about 5 m, center-right; one at about 2 m, front-right at the edge of frame. None on the far right sidewalk. The pipe stays where it fell.

takes.notes: REQUEST S06-SH025-a, draft, Leonard approved 12 credits ("Ok go"). Folder S06/SH025. Text plus elements, no previz. Claude's read: photographic, black worn PPK-style pistol in side profile, muzzle screen right, right hand with charcoal sleeve and white cuff from the left, locked-off, soft warm square behind, nobody in frame. Three firing cycles, not four: at about 0.0 s, 1.9 s and 2.4 s, each with a muzzle flash, the slide back exposing the barrel and a brass casing flipping up and out of frame, smoke from the port. 0.4 to 1.9 s the gun just holds with smoke; 2.6 to 4 s holds with smoke. Audio: three shot transients at those times, no music heard in the level scan; not yet checked by ear. Light reads flat hazy rather than a clear raking sun from screen left. For a 3 s cut: 1.0 to 4.0 s holds two shots. Leonard 2026-11-19: the background is too distant; the gun expels bullets with tips instead of empty shells; it should not be slow motion. T02 (prompts/001_S06_SH025_T02.txt): background three to five meters behind the gun (soft crowd and a wall), shells described as empty hollow brass casings with no tip, real-time speed spelled out.

REQUEST S06-SH025-b, draft, Leonard approved 12 credits ("ok go"). Folder S06/SH025. Changes from T01: close background, empty shells, real-time speed. Claude's read: real speed now: each shot cycles in one or two frames with motion blur, the flash is a single blurred burst. Shells read as short brass tubes, flung up and out of frame in about six frames. Five shots, not four (sound transients at 0.1, 1.0, 1.7, 2.25, 2.7 s): the same count as SH020. Background NOT fixed: the crowd is still about 20 to 50 m away, small crouching and running figures across a wide square, a long wall far behind, hazy golden backlight with sun rays. The camera sits low: a blurred strip of sandy ground right under the hand. White French cuff with a small blue cufflink. Audio not yet checked by ear. Leonard 2026-11-19: the gun is correct; the hand rests on a wall and must not; behind the gun there must be a wall, not a crowd. T03 (prompts/001_S06_SH025_T03_v2.txt): a new take, T02's prompt plus the plain weathered concrete wall of loc_square about two meters behind and the arm in free air. (A video_edit prompt, 001_S06_SH025_T03.txt, was withdrawn unsubmitted: style.md forbids video_edit.)

REQUEST S06-SH025-d, draft, Leonard approved 12 credits ("ok go"). Folder S06/SH025. New take: T02's prompt plus a close concrete wall and the arm in free air. Claude's read: the out-of-focus concrete wall fills the whole background, a lit vertical edge at the far left; no people. The arm is held out in free air, nothing under it. Black PPK-style gun, now turned slightly toward camera (grip more visible), red indicator dot near the hammer. Three shots, not four (sound at 0.0, 0.87, 1.78 s), each with flash, slide back and a short brass casing flung up. The slide stays back about six frames per shot and the casings rise across eight or more frames: faster than T01, slower than T02's one-to-two-frame cycle. 2.0 to 4.0 s the gun just holds. Audio not yet checked by ear. Leonard 2026-11-19: still slow motion, still ejecting bullets instead of shells. Cause (Claude): three prompts described the slide and the ejected shell in close detail, the look of high-speed gun footage; slowed down, the casing becomes readable and is drawn as a whole round. T04 (prompts/001_S06_SH025_T04.txt): same wall and arm, the mechanism no longer described: real-time 24 fps, recoil a one-frame blur, the casing a brass glint gone in a frame; five shots in the first 3 s (the five of SH020).

REQUEST S06-SH025-e, draft, Leonard approved 12 credits ("ok go"). Folder S06/SH025. Change from T03: the mechanism no longer described, real-time 24 fps, five fast shots asked.
